name: Villa Rashmi
description:
Villa Rashmi is a one-of-a-kind 100-year old heritage villa in Mumbai with over 50 rooms, located on a dead-end road in the heart of the suburb of Malad. The villa itself is a part of a larger Bhadran Bhuvan Estate owned solely by Shri Haresh M. Patel, who was born there.

Villa Rashmi has been carefully restored to its original state as when it was built prior to 1920, with authentic Victorian antique furniture, high wooden sloping ceilings, spacious and bright rooms with heritage tiles, private balconies, large verandahs, courtyard etcetera, but fitted with modern amenities for today’s comfort.

The architecture and ambience of the heritage villa has been appreciated by creative directors, artists, photographers, celebrities etc.

I am very fond of birding in Sattal, Uttarakhand, and have visited the region several times earlier on my own for birding and bird photography. This time, I joined a 4-day birding trip organised by NK Jungle Trail, led by Mr. N. K. Rajput, and it turned out to be a truly memorable experience.

Mr. N. K. Rajput organised the trip exceptionally well. Our stay was at Bhimtal Lodge, run by Mr. Prabhu, a well-known and highly respected birding guide in the Sattal region. Both Mr. Prabhu and Mr. NK Rajput took us to various birding hotspots around Sattal and ensured that almost all the birds on our checklist were sighted. Their local knowledge, patience, and ability to spot and identify birds were truly commendable.

I am 62 years old, and apart from me, there were seven other birders in the group. One of them, Mr. Ravi, is 70 years old, while the remaining six were youngsters in the age group of 30–35 years. Despite the age differences, the group bonded beautifully. The younger members mingled very well with us seniors, and sharing birding knowledge, photography tips, and life experiences made the trip even more special.

Beyond birding, we thoroughly enjoyed the travel time, evening chit-chats, and relaxed discussions after long days in the field. The entire team was extremely supportive, caring, and respectful, always ensuring that everyone was comfortable and well taken care of.

Overall, this trip was not just about bird sightings—it was about companionship, learning, mutual respect, and creating lasting memories. I sincerely thank NK Jungle Trail, Mr. N. K. Rajput, and Mr. Prabhu for organizing such a wonderful and enriching birding experience. I would highly recommend NK Jungle Trail to anyone interested in birding in Sattal.

featured_reviews.review_text:
In December 2018, I and my wife (with our 9 months old daughter) were preparing to go to Mumbai for the first time from Delhi to attend a marriage in the month of February 2019.

Checking online we came across Mumbai Darshan Tour buses being operated in Mumbai. After thoroughly going through multiple reviews for about a month, none of the bus services was convincing due to bad and better to say disgusting reviews. I decided to either go by our own cab or don't even try at all.

After visiting Mumbai, people over there give us confidence and we thought to give it a try. We finally decided to take Shubhra Sharma Travels bus for Mumbai Darshan, as it was the only bus where few seats were already booked 2 days in advance.

And then all good thing happened on the tour day. As soon as we boarded the bus, we sensed that something better is about to happen. We met this Guy Shankar, our tour guide in the bus, who was a lean guy in his early 30s, looking a lot younger than his actual age. He was energetic, helpful and had a good command on his narrative skills. He possessed all the good quality of an average tour guide you may find in such a bus.

The AC bus was quite good considering a full day tour, however, it also had the operable windows as we have in normal buses. (Later we opened the window a little and enjoyed the fresh humid weather of Mumbai in a bus :D ). The fellow passengers were from all part of India and were supportive too.

As soon as our bus started, Shankar started explaining the important rules, places to visit and other things to remember during the tour. He narrated all this using a small mic which also showed how much experience he had.

The tour happened smoothly and on time, and we enjoyed and had fun visiting all the places. I would like to say Thank You to Shankar for such a memorable journey.

Bonus: We later found out that he boards the same travels every day on Borivali route. So bet better on your luck to board Shankar’s bus for a mesmerizing journey. :)

Here's Shankar after a full day of fun-filled adventure tour of Mumbai.

featured_reviews.review_text: As a solo traveler, The Mind Voyage's Morocco itinerary with Mohana felt like a personal whisper from the desert. featured_reviews.review_text:
This was my first group trip and first with TMV. It was my friend who coaxed me to sign up for this trip & I can’t thank her enough for making me experience this wonderful trip to Italy. This is one of the most memorable trips I have taken so far. The itinerary was extensive and very well planned, stretching to a period of fourteen days in different cities of beautiful Italy. And I must say my jaw dropped every time we entered a new city, seeing the amazing architecture, beautiful countryside and stunning/diverse landscapes. It was a relaxed trip with no rushing to the next place, though most of us felt adding few more days would have made the trip perfect. Nevertheless It was a very well planned itinerary with diverse experiences ranging from the wine tasting in the lush green countryside Tuscany, beach hopping in picturesque Cinque terre, exploring rich history in majestic Rome and amazing Pompeii ruins, gondola ride in the fascinating maze of canals in Venice and hiking in spectacular Dolomites (which remains my most favourite). Especially the road journey from Bolzano to Dolomites will remain etched in my memory forever for the beautiful landscapes with miles of vast green meadows, tall pine trees, terraced vineyards and beautiful country houses with bright pink/red flowers hanging from the balconies.
A big shoutout to Mohana who dons the hat of the sailor and the chef with equal expertise. She was not only available 24*7 for us but also a vey amiable companion. She very lovingly prepared a very sumptuous Indian meal for all of us in Como which was one of the most beautiful gestures I have experienced in a long time. May you soar higher girl💖.
This trip will always hold a very special spot in my heart for all the right reasons and looking forward to many more with my girl gang and TMV.

In addition we'd already spent a hectic 5 weeks in India - we were tired, grumpy, waiting to fly back home and not at all looking forward to our last 4 days in Mumbai at all. So basically when our travel companions insisted we book a tour - the scene was set for disaster...
'Bombay Walks' single handedly turned this around and Mumbai actually turned out to be the highlight of our trip! (Nope this is not a sponsored review 😂)

The tour: Arpan's tour extends to the days before and after the actual tour as he offers valuable advice about where to stay/eat/party/shop etc. He speaks perfect English, is pleasant and very easy to communicate with. His passion and love for the city is infectious and you will end his tour enthralled, overwhelmed and completely charmed by Mumbai and it's people - vowing to come back and dig deeper, spend longer and see more. The city tour covers many facets of the city - traveling to hidden gems and local landmarks across the length and breadth of Mumbai. You get to see and experience aspects of Mumbai that you'd never be able to do alone with a guide book or google maps - like traveling on local trains and walking through Worli fishing village and stopping by at small off-the-beaten path temples and churches.

The guide: Arpan is reliable, trustworthy and comes well prepared for the type of group. His talking style is light-hearted and easy going but still knowledgeable and always engaging. He's the type of guide that can tell you interesting facts about the history, architecture and politics of a place but also where to get the best coconut water along the way and which public toilets are ok to use.
We only met Arpan in person on the day of the tour and although we were constantly bombarded with sights, sounds and smells (it is Mumbai after all) - it never once felt like we were just being dragged from point to point whilst he rattled off information but rather that we were spending the day walking around with an old friend.

Target travelers: We're fairly well travelled and yet this is the first time we've ever bothered to leave a tour review - on any platform - I think that in itself indicates how highly we recommend this tour.
This is really a 'must do' in Mumbai.
It's so good we would do this tour again even if it were to cover the exact route we already took. The walking wasn't particular strenuous so it's recommended for any age group it should also be noted that we found that     Arpan was discreetly always conscious of where the group members were and their safety and constantly aware of our surroundings and the locals around us - on that note I would recommend this tour even if you're a single female traveling alone.

When to do it: Try and do this tour on your first full day in Mumbai because it's also a great way to orientate yourself around the city and plan the rest of your time there.

That city that everyone talks about - that's all of India's many faces and layers in one, that accepts everyone, that's everyone's home - regardless of language, religion or creed - Mumbai is THAT city and you'd be crazy if you miss the opportunity to let a born-and-bred local guide you around...

Sewri Fort in Mumbai is a captivating historical landmark that offers a glimpse into the city's rich past. With its intriguing architecture and serene surroundings, it is a must-visit destination for history enthusiasts and explorers alike.

The fort's age-old stone walls exude a sense of grandeur, evoking memories of its colonial and maritime significance. As you wander through the ruins, you'll be transported back in time to an era when the fort played a crucial role in safeguarding the city against potential invaders.

The location of Sewri Fort adds to its charm. Situated along the eastern waterfront of Mumbai, it provides a stunning panoramic view of the sea and mangroves, making it a delightful spot for photography and relaxation.

Though the fort is in ruins, the Maharashtra Government has taken measures to preserve its heritage, adding information boards that share historical anecdotes. The fort's simplicity and lack of commercialization add to its allure, allowing visitors to soak in the authentic essence of Mumbai's history.

However, it is essential to note that the site lacks amenities and can be challenging to access for people with mobility issues due to uneven terrain. Nevertheless, the overall experience of visiting Sewri Fort is rewarding and educational, offering a memorable journey through Mumbai's past.

Amongst all these forts I think Bandra Fort and Sewri Fort are decently taken care by the authorities. Sewri Fort is just about 1-2km distance from Sewri station. It's strategic location is such that you can enjoy sunrise ⛅ if you go early on the morning. A beautiful red sun coming out of Creek water presents magnificent view. Fort is relatively in good shape though it's not a very big fort but it's structure is very much intact. At one side of the fort is a huge Creek from where you can see classic Flamingo point where thousands of flamingo migrates every year to this place and from the other side of the fort you can see highrise buildings of Mumbai. There is also a Durga near to this fort with good number of huge trees around presenting a nice view soothing to the eyes.

There is no security guards taking care of this fort and there is no entry fees also. We reached to this place on our cycles and found approach road in a good condition. If you visit to this Fort, don't forget to visit Flamingo point also which is half a km from this place. Don't expect too much from this place but you won't b disappointed if you visit this place.

Hope you will find my review useful. I recommend you to discover this hidden and unknown place of Mumbai and spread a word so more n more people visits this place and authorities awakes to take good care of this fort.

featured_reviews.name: Ishaan Srivastav
featured_reviews.review_text: We had the pleasure of taking the inside CSMT (Crown Jewel of Mumbai) tour with Sarthak Mahajan, and he was exceptional. Sarthak is incredibly knowledgeable, seamlessly weaving together stories of the building’s storied past with insights into its present-day operations. His passion for the history of the station is evident, and he made the entire walk a very pleasant, fun and engaging experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking to truly understand the soul of this UNESCO World Heritage site!

featured_reviews.name: Carol Thomson
featured_reviews.review_text:
The CST tour was a great experience.
It really felt like stepping into a whole different world full of history and amazing architecture.

Our guide, Sarthak, was exceptional. He eloquently walked us through the evolution of Indian Railways and the fascinating story behind CST, bringing every detail to life.
He also took us to all the best spots, which made it even better.

The architecture is just beautiful and so diverse—you can really see why it’s a UNESCO World Heritage site.

Overall, it was a memorable time and I’m really grateful to Sarthak for all the insights and knowledge that he shared.

featured_reviews.name: Samar Devdass
featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Howard Kaplan
featured_reviews.review_text:
we did the essential Mumbai tour with Parvez. he was a great guide for a great trip. The tour started off near the Asiatic society, and we walked around the area originally inside the Fort walls. He helped create a wonderful imagery of what the city looked like when it was founded along with some stories about the history before hand that led up to establishing Mumbai.
The trip was a mixture of walking and getting in and out of a car to see various sites around the city. It was quite varied and allowed us to see some unusual sites we would not have seen by ourselves.
at the end of the tour, we stopped at a restaurant with Parvez and tried several dishes that were excellent. Common food that is regularly served in restaurants, but this was delicious.

If this was representative of the companies tou, I would strongly recommend them for a tour.

featured_reviews.name: Varun Khandka
featured_reviews.review_text:
This afternoon we went for a heritage walk of the BMC office. We randomly signed up for this, thought its better to do something rather than just sitting home, but this was so much more than just "something".
We met Mr. Mickey, who led the walk, such an amazing, lively and knowledgeable guy. He kept the whole walk so engaging, the way he explained us about the things was truly outstanding. This was one of the best things to experience in Mumbai, we have already planned to do the fort walk and we are definitely going to sign up for more with Khaki Tours.

Walking tour with Khakhi, helped us see the details that we have never noticed, heard stories that we did not know and helped us appreciate the history behind the buildings.

Our tour guide (Omkar) was very patient (especially with our 9 year old) and knowledgeable. He gave us a detailed tour and explained the nuances.

I would highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to know about the history of Mumbai

featured_reviews.name: Sandy D

It was brutally hot the day we took the tour, but Sagar was patient, engaging, and took the time to explain everything in detail. Highly recommended for anyone wanting to experience and understand Mumbai beyond the usual tourist spots.

featured_reviews.name: Tejal Samant
featured_reviews.review_text: We visited the BMC Headquarters with Khaki Tours on 25th May, and it was an absolutely awesome experience! The heritage architecture of the building is simply stunning — a true gem in the heart of Mumbai. Every Mumbaikar should and must visit this iconic place to appreciate the city's rich history and civic pride. Our tour guide, Juzer Tambawalla, was incredibly knowledgeable and engaging, bringing the stories of this magnificent structure to life. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: P K
featured_reviews.review_text: We had arranged for a group tour of Castle 2 Gateway through Khakee Tour. It was the best experience we ever had. We had 55 people in group most of them born and bought up in Mumbai. But we didnt knew even 10% history and facts of what they showed and explained us. We had 3 sub groups but everybody had excellent experience with their guides. Our tour guide was Parag who was fabulous. His passion for Mumbai was evident. A must do tour for every mumbaikar

featured_reviews.name: Max Mackie
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mumbai history comes alive! An amazing walk with Surabhi.

I recently took the Fort area heritage walk with Khaki Tours, and I cannot recommend it enough. Our guide, Surabhi, was absolutely fantastic.
It wasn’t just a recitation of dates and facts; Surabhi is a natural storyteller. She wove together the history of colonial Bombay with fascinating anecdotes about the architecture and the people who built this city. She pointed out hidden details in the Gothic buildings that I would have walked right past without noticing.

Her energy was contagious, and she was incredibly patient in answering all our questions. Whether you are a tourist or a local Mumbaikar, you will see the Fort area with completely new eyes after this. If you book a Khaki Tour, definitely ask for Surabhi!
